title.en: scotland v north macedonia at hampden.

line.en: uefa nations league at hampden park, kick-off 19:45 on friday. the scottish fa calls it the last home game of 2026.
line.de: uefa nations league im hampden park, anpfiff freitag 19:45. der schottische verband nennt es das letzte heimspiel 2026.
line.tr: uefa uluslar ligi, hampden park'ta, cuma 19:45'te başlıyor. iskoç futbol federasyonu bunu 2026'nın son iç saha maçı olarak anıyor.

sparks.why: Scotland v North Macedonia, Nations League at Hampden Park, Fri 13 Nov 19:45, per the Scottish FA announcement; ESPN lists a different weekday and time, so check before going.
